levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the seven required sections is missing from the index.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All seven sections appear on the index with a status marked.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The gap-prioritization reasoning is specific and realistic, not just 'I'll do them in order.'

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: A section is marked 'have it' without the learner being able to name actual evidence for it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every 'have it' marking is backed by nameable evidence.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reflection shows genuine recalibration between the warm-up guess and the honest audit, not defensiveness.

lookFors: All seven required sections are present on the index.
No section is marked complete without nameable evidence behind it.
The gap-prioritization choice is explained with a real reason, not arbitrary.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
